meta.basis: Nutrients per 100 g of cooked dish, EXCLUDING added cooking fat. Added oil, ghee or butter is a separate item: added_fat gives grams of fat per 100 g of dish for home, restaurant and street cooking.
meta.energy_formula: kcal = 4 x protein + 4 x available carbs + 9 x fat + 2 x fibre (FAO / IFCT factors)
sources: IFCT 2017, ICMR NIN (ingredient composition, via the @ifct2017/compositions digitisation)
Standard recipes and cooked yields (in house estimates)
Typical published values for non Indian fast food (estimates)

micro.basis: Per 100 g of cooked dish from IFCT 2017 ingredients. Vitamins C, folate and A multiplied by 0.7 for cooking (calculated values run 32% to 45.5% high, Chiplonkar and Agte 2007), except raw dishes. Vitamin A = retinol + beta carotene / 8; IFCT gives no retinol for milk, so dairy vitamin A is undercounted. Added cooking fat adds no minerals or vitamins here. Fast food rows have no minerals or vitamins (micro is null).
micro.not_covered: Vitamin B12, vitamin D, iodine and added salt are not counted.

meta.flags_note: flags: dairy, ghee_fat (ghee or butter as the home cooking fat), egg, meat, fish, jain_avoid (roots, tubers, onion, mushroom). Computed from recipe ingredients; fast food set by hand.
meta.units_note: Medium katori 150 g (DGI 2024 lists 155 ml); serving ladle 60 g; glass 250 ml; cup 150 ml. Piece weights are estimates.
meta.licence_note: Prototype only. IFCT data needs written permission from ICMR NIN before commercial use.
